sealed_synthetic_oracle.purpose: evaluation only; never passed to ConsolidationEngine

restricted_observation_scope: Structural memory classes, in-memory synthetic events only; no production I/O or authority

adjudication_rules.t1: RECORDED or UNKNOWN; no assertion truth promotion
adjudication_rules.t2: UNKNOWN unless evidence policy authenticates source and resolves conflict
adjudication_rules.t3: A scoped negative assessment may be justified only when C authenticity, temporal scope and evidence relation are established independently. Otherwise NOT_IMPLEMENTED or UNKNOWN.
adjudication_rules.t4: The first assessment must be a typed target of a new versioned assessment. On C calibration fault, T3 justification is withdrawn; current epistemic outcome UNKNOWN unless new admissible evidence exists.
adjudication_rules.anti_recency: Age alone may not upgrade veracity.
adjudication_rules.duplicate_replay: Replay same event id and digest must not produce additional epistemic events or unintended reinforcement.
adjudication_rules.missing_receipt: An in-memory hash string is not independently authenticated source bytes.
adjudication_rules.root_independence: Several declared witnesses sharing a root are not independent sources.
adjudication_rules.order: Result of conflict must not vary solely because a legitimate negation arrived first.
adjudication_rules.historical: Never erase earlier claims or assessments; preserve reason and exact supersession link.

classification: Expected FAIL is an anticipated safety assertion failure, marked strict XFAIL in pytest. XFAIL does not count as PASS. NOT_IMPLEMENTED is an absent required behavior, not a tested runtime failure. Unexpected XPASS must fail CI.
minimum_controls: P01 counterbalances N01/N03/N08; P02 counterbalances N02/N07; P03 counterbalances N06; P04 counterbalances N10; P05 counterbalances N04; N09 has no valid source-authority positive without external authenticated custody.
inference_limits: frozen synthetic truth not live reality
GitHub CI does not authenticate physical source, origin, reviewer, or claim truth
